_readme: Physics owns this file. One entry per action a player can choose. A value stays null until it has a source logged in docs/SOURCES.md. The game shows 'figure being checked' for null values and leaves them out of totals, so no made-up number reaches the demo.
disclaimer: Estimates for learning purposes. Each figure comes from the source listed in our methodology. Figures marked 'being checked' are not sourced yet.

days_per_year._source_school_day: England: 190 pupil days per school year. Confirm and cite in docs/SOURCES.md.

wrapper_binned.label: Put your wrapper in the bin
wrapper_binned.consequence: The wrapper is collected instead of blowing into hedges, drains and rivers.

wrapper_littered.label: Dropped your wrapper on the ground
wrapper_littered.consequence: Litter can end up in drains and rivers, where it breaks into tiny pieces that animals swallow.

bottle_single_use.label: Bought a plastic bottle of water
bottle_single_use.consequence: A new bottle is made, used once, then thrown away.

tap_off.label: Turned the tap off while brushing
tap_off.consequence: Water only runs when you need it.

tap_running.label: Left the tap running while brushing
tap_running.consequence: Clean drinking water goes straight down the drain.
tap_running._assumption: State tap flow rate (litres/min) and brushing time (min) in SOURCES.md and on screen.

shower_long.label: Had a long 10-minute shower
shower_long.consequence: Heating extra water uses energy as well as water.
shower_long._assumption: Store the EXTRA water/CO2e compared with a 4-minute shower (6 extra minutes x flow rate). State the flow rate in SOURCES.md.

equivalents._readme: Comparisons for the report, e.g. 'about the same as N bathtubs'. per_unit stays null until sourced, and is not shown until then.
